title: 第13章 孙悟空 我说的都是真的第14章 四木星君被坑惨了
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: 太白金星一直在给孙悟空暗示。
毕竟陛下金口玉言。
孙悟空看向在场的众位神仙。
原本的武斗派，托塔天王李靖更是低下脑袋，不知道在想什么。
太白金星悄悄传音道。
“陛下金口玉言，还不谢恩！”
孙悟空感觉即使是四木星君下界，也无法战胜那强盗的。
不过既然如此，只能公事公办了。
“太白，我就相信你一次。”
玉皇大帝看到孙悟空给了他的面子。
也就没有继续刁难。
“好，命令四木星君下界调查禁魔之地，擒拿盗贼，夺回行李。”
玉皇大帝非常随意地命令道。
孙悟空重重的叹了一口气。
他知道肯定不会是那人的对手。
不过没办法。
他来天天求援。
玉皇大帝已经安排人手应对。
现在只能公事公办。
而且，孙悟空不知道的事。
玉皇大帝并没有相信孙悟空所言，孙悟空和唐僧不和是众所周知的事情，两人经常闹一些小矛盾。
什么强盗打劫。
什么禁魔之地？
玉皇大帝根本就不相信。
什么强盗能比孙悟空强？
无非是孙悟空耍的小性子罢了。
太白金星领了法旨，直接将令牌交给了奎木狼。
“咳咳！
大圣这就是奎木狼，之前你们可能有一些误会……”
太白金星之所以建议四木星君下界。
为的就是调解孙悟空和奎木狼之间的矛盾。
太白金星的面子自然是要给的。
而且黄袍怪的事情早就揭过了。
“如此说来，多谢四位，奎木狼此次下界还需你多多出力哦！”
孙悟空说话说的非常巧妙。
content_en:
Taibai Jinxing has been giving hints to Sun Wukong.
After all, His Majesty speaks the truth.
Sun Wukong looked at the gods present.
Li Jing, the original martial arts sect and the Tota King, even lowered his head, not knowing what he was thinking.
Taibai Jinxing whispered.
"Your Majesty is so eloquent that you still don't thank me!"
Sun Wukong felt that even Simu Xingjun in the lower realm could not defeat the robber.
But in this case, it can only be done business.
"Taibai, I will believe you just once."
The Jade Emperor saw the face Sun Wukong had given him.
He didn't continue to make things difficult.
"Okay, order Simu Xingjun to go down to the realm to investigate the forbidden demon place, capture the thieves, and take back the luggage."
The Jade Emperor ordered very casually.
Sun Wukong sighed heavily.
He knew that he would definitely not be his opponent.
But there is no way.
He comes every day asking for help.
The Jade Emperor has already arranged manpower to deal with it.
Now we can only do business.
Moreover, there is something Sun Wukong doesn’t know.
The Jade Emperor did not believe what Sun Wukong said. It was well known that Sun Wukong and Tang Seng were at odds, and the two often had minor conflicts.
What a robber.
What forbidden place?
The Jade Emperor didn't believe it at all.
What robber can be stronger than Sun Wukong?
It's nothing more than Sun Wukong's petty temper.
Taibai Jinxing received the decree and handed the token directly to Kui Mulang.
"Ahem!
Great Sage, this is Kui Mulang, you may have had some misunderstandings before..."
The reason why Taibaijinxing suggested that Mr. Sijuxing go down to the lower realm.
The purpose is to mediate the conflict between Sun Wukong and Kui Mulang.
Naturally, Taibai Jinxing’s face must be given.
Moreover, the matter of the yellow-robed monster has long been revealed.
"In that case, thank you all four, Kui Mulang still needs your efforts in this lower realm!"
Sun Wukong spoke very cleverly.
title_en: Chapter 13: Sun Wukong, everything I said is true Chapter 14: Mr. Simu Xing was tricked
